text_block_list.text:
One day, while working in the trainer's 
office—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'm really sorry, but could I 
take a break from training today?
choice_data_list: Did something happen?
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I helped a pony-chan 
who almost fell down the stairs, but—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I hurt my leg a bit back then, you see. 
It's probably best if I don't run for the 
rest of today.
choice_data_list:
Are you okay? Should I walk you back to 
the dorm?

Are you okay? Want me to walk you back to 
the dorms?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I can't walk, I'm fine. I 
just want to rest up just in case... See 
ya.

From her perspective, she's likely being 
considerate of the Umamusume responsible 
and trying not to cause worry for others.

Still, her symptoms might get worse. 
Respecting her feelings, I headed to the 
school store to "casually" buy her a 
refreshment.

Along with the pain relief tape, I buy 
Fuji Kiseki's favorite treats and bag them 
so only the food is visible from the 
outside. And then—
choice_data_list: Hey, do you have a moment?
Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Fuji-san's trainer~! What is it, 
what is it~?
choice_data_list:
Can you deliver Fuji's forgotten item to 
the dorm?

Could you deliver Fuji's forgotten item to 
the dorm for me?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so much food~! Fuji-san, you must 
have been super hungry!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Sure, leave it to me! I'll deliver it in a 
flash!

No sooner had she said it than Haru Urara 
cheerfully ran off.

If the sender is someone as honest and 
innocent as her, Fuji Kiseki wouldn't need 
to stay on guard.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The swelling has gone down, but it might 
be better to postpone the dorm patrol a 
little longer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hiding my injury, alone in my room— it 
kinda takes me back to when I was 
little...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(I got injured during rehearsal the day 
before a performance... and there was a 
time I wanted to whine and show weakness, 
just like a normal kid.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, before I was a child, I was a 
stage actor first—)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Found you, Fuji-san! Urara Express 
delivery is here!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, well... What an adorable little 
courier we have here.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ Um, so, Trainer gave me something 
Fuji-san left behind to return to you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Don't forget next time, okay~? See ya!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"‘Lost property’, huh... The contents are 
food, and... this."
And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer-san!
choice_data_list:
Looks like you've made a full recovery, 
huh.
Looks like you've made a full recovery!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks to the "lost item" you handed 
to Urara, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: I wish you'd lean on me, at least.
I wish you'd lean on me, at least.
We help each other out when in need!
We help each other out when in need!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks to the "lost item" you handed 
to Urara, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: I wish you'd lean on me, at least.
I wish you'd lean on me, at least.
We help each other out when in need!
We help each other out when in need!

text_block_list.text:
I told her that I'm Fuji Kiseki's Trainer 
and the adult here. When I did—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. You really are 
dependable, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Back when I was a child actor, I got 
injured once. Today just brought back 
memories of that time for the first time 
in a while."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I didn't have a Trainer... So 
things were a little different from now.
choice_data_list: Was I able to be of some support to you?
Was I able to support you, even a little?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That is already more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly. You really are quite the 
heartbreaker, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pampering me like that, trying to take off 
my mask... If I end up unable to live 
without you, what will you do?
choice_data_list: T-That's...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just kidding♪ See you at training 
time!

No matter how you look at it, you're the 
heartbreaker here... I held my head in my 
hands as I watched her walk away.

No matter how you look at it, you're the 
heartbreaker here... I held my head in my 
hands as I watched your back fade into the 
distance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The feeling's mutual, huh? I see how it 
is."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, if you ever get hurt, 
Trainer-san, maybe I'll bring you some 
get-well treats.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll borrow the dorm cafeteria and cook up 
a whole bunch of nutritious meals!
choice_data_list:
I'm happy, but... your fans are going to 
be jealous of me

I'm happy, but... your fans might get 
jealous of me

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In that case, when I come to visit, I'll 
drop by without anyone else noticing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Just like Romeo going to meet Juliet—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Will you wait for me, my Juliet? ...Just 
kidding♪

Part of me is looking forward to that 
time, while another part is a little 
worried...

With mixed emotions in my heart, I looked 
back at Fuji Kiseki, who seemed thoroughly 
amused.
